game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Stump Court, a court around a giant stump: the wood elf archer must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Stump Court: a court around a giant stump
core_gameplay_loop: In Stump Court, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, shadow wolves strike the herb garden, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the herb garden from shadow wolves in Stump Court: keep the picks_right meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: picks_right drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
